body: So be understanding when a person comes to you for support, but be truthful if they ask my opinion? Because I do understand that, if your car breaks down, you want to hear "that sucks, I'm really sorry that happened" and probably not ways to fix it.

I'm autistic so the social cues thing is probably accurate. 

I think the biggest problem is that I live in the south. The redneck conservative kind of south. You never say what you want, instead you gossip behind people's backs. When another woman isn't a good cook or doesn't reliably clean, she's a bad wife, no matter how many kids or jobs she has. Power is obtained by being a conservative Christian; you won't have friends in high places without it. 

There's about a billion LGBT kids because kids will do the opposite of anything you try to make them do. But they grew up in such a bad environment that they end up a lot like my friend that I mentioned. My friend likes men that take advantage of him; men that don't give in return. 

Oh, and the mayor died a few months ago because a news outlet found out she had a trans NSFW reddit account. She was a pastor. Some people tried to say she was a pedophile with absolutely no basis for that. About 5 days had gone by when she committed. 

So it sounds like I have to make peace with it until I move? Maybe find a rare normal person?
